"#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build report.pptx (4 slides) from perf_06.csv — data-anchored engineering test briefing."""

import csv
import os

from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt

CSV_PATH = "perf_06.csv"
OUT_PATH = "report.pptx"

COLUMNS = ["config", "cl_max", "cd_cruise", "ld_ratio"]


def read_data(path):
    """Read CSV, return (records, raw_rows). raw_rows preserve original strings for the table."""
    with open(path, newline="", encoding="utf-8-sig") as f:
        rows = [r for r in csv.reader(f) if any(c.strip() for c in r)]
    header = [h.strip().lower() for h in rows[0]]
    idx = {name: header.index(name) for name in COLUMNS}

    records = []
    raw_rows = []
    for r in rows[1:]:
        rec = {
            "config": r[idx["config"]].strip(),
            "cl_max": float(r[idx["cl_max"]]),
            "cd_cruise": float(r[idx["cd_cruise"]]),
            "ld_ratio": float(r[idx["ld_ratio"]]),
        }
        records.append(rec)
        raw_rows.append([r[idx[c]].strip() for c in COLUMNS])
    return records, raw_rows


def compute_summary(records):
    n = len(records)
    clmax_max = max(r["cl_max"] for r in records)
    cd_mean = sum(r["cd_cruise"] for r in records) / n
    ld_mean = sum(r["ld_ratio"] for r in records) / n
    best = max(records, key=lambda r: r["ld_ratio"])["config"]
    return clmax_max, cd_mean, ld_mean, best


def build_deck(records, raw_rows, clmax_max, cd_mean, ld_mean, best):
    prs = Presentation()

    clmax_max_s = f"{clmax_max:.3f}"   # 0.578
    cd_mean_s = f"{cd_mean:.4f}"       # 0.0331
    ld_mean_s = f"{ld_mean:.1f}"       # 16.6

    # ---------- Slide 1: Title ----------
    slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[0])
    slide.shapes.title.text = "Engineering Test Briefing"
    slide.placeholders[1].text = "Aerodynamic performance summary (perf_06)"

    # ---------- Slide 2: Data table ----------
    slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[5])  # Title Only
    slide.shapes.title.text = "Data"

    n_rows = 1 + len(records)
    tbl_shape = slide.shapes.add_table(n_rows, 4, Inches(0.8), Inches(1.6),
                                       Inches(8.4), Inches(0.4 * n_rows))
    table = tbl_shape.table

    for j, name in enumerate(COLUMNS):
        cell = table.cell(0, j)
        cell.text = name
        for p in cell.text_frame.paragraphs:
            for run in p.runs:
                run.font.bold = True
                run.font.size = Pt(14)

    for i, row_vals in enumerate(raw_rows, start=1):
        for j, val in enumerate(row_vals):

            cell.text = val
            for p in cell.text_frame.paragraphs:
                for run in p.runs:
                    run.font.size = Pt(12)

    # ---------- Slide 3: Summary ----------
    slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[5])
    slide.shapes.title.text = "Summary"

    body = slide.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(0.8), Inches(1.7), Inches(8.4), Inches(4.0))
    tf = body.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True

        f"CDcruise mean = {cd_mean_s}",
        f"L/D mean = {ld_mean_s}",

    ]
